# 48. Dismantle notifyd staging environment

Date: 2024-08-26

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A [discussion was opened](https://github.com/github/notifyd/discussions/4132) about whether having the notifyd staging environment was cost effective and possible alternatives.

## Decision

Notifyd staging environment is not considered cost-effective.

## Consequences

- notifyd staging environment [will be dismantled](https://github.com/github/notifyd/issues/4209)
